about: Stands in for the person's wavex connector in scripts/bridge-sim.mjs. One owned automation. Made-up data.

reply-in-my-voice.name: Reply in My Voice
reply-in-my-voice.summary: Paste an email. You get a reply in your own voice, saved as a draft.

inputs.label: Paste the email you want to answer
inputs.example: Hi, can we move our call to Thursday at 3?

inputs.label: How long should the reply be?

steps.title: Write the reply
steps.prompt:
Write a {{length}} reply to this email, in a warm and direct voice:

{{email}}

steps.title: Save it as a Gmail draft
